metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent opened GIMP Windows menu and clicked Hide Docks in 3 turns (score=1.0). Demonstrated menu navigation for GIMP display settings.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate GIMP menus; icon theme is set via Edit > Preferences > Interface > Icon Theme
metadata.explanation: Retains same GIMP menu-navigation demonstrated capability and adds a GIMP Preferences change. Icon theme is configured under Edit > Preferences > Interface. Evaluator reads gimprc after quit and checks for icon-theme=Symbolic (case-insensitive).

llm_judge_reasons: Postconfig correctly quits GIMP via Ctrl+Q before reading gimprc, ensuring preferences are flushed to disk on exit.
Getter correctly reads ~/.config/GIMP/2.10/gimprc and parses GIMP's Scheme-like config format '(icon-theme "Symbolic")' by stripping parentheses and quotes.
Metric correctly handles expected.type='rule': receives {'icon_theme': 'Symbolic'} directly and accesses it with expected.get('icon_theme', 'symbolic') — no wrong expected.get('rules') anti-pattern.
Case-insensitive comparison ensures 'Symbolic' matches regardless of capitalization in gimprc.
Expected value {'icon_theme': 'Symbolic'} is semantically correct for the instruction.
Negative control resistance is good: if icon-theme entry is absent in gimprc (default state), getter returns {'icon_theme': 'unknown'} which correctly fails the metric.
Single-requirement instruction has complete coverage from a single evaluator check.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: The metric uses 'expected_val in actual' (substring check) rather than strict equality. Consider using 'actual == expected_val' to avoid false positives if a hypothetical theme name contained 'symbolic' as a substring. Practically not a concern for known GIMP theme names.
